skill_description: Shortcut for coding agents: prints the JGates skill (how to validate, read the result and fix without changing the criteria); --path prints where it is and --install <folder> copies it into the agent's skills folder.
skill_option_path: Only the path of this installation's SKILL.md.
skill_option_install: Copies the skill to <folder>/SKILL.md (for example your agent's skills folder).
skill_option_force: With --install, replaces a different SKILL.md already there.
skill_unexpected_argument_fix: Use jgates skill, jgates skill --path or jgates skill --install <folder>.
skill_missing: The skill was not found at {path}.
skill_missing_fix: Reinstall JGates: the package ships jgates/skill/SKILL.md.
skill_exists: A different SKILL.md already exists at {path}.
skill_exists_fix: Check the file and repeat with --force to replace it, or choose another folder.
skill_write_failed_fix: Check the folder and its permissions.
skill_installed_same: The skill at {path} is already this version's.
